verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbabor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins: and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: et spíritum rectum ínova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua: et Spíritum Sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face: and take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation: and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sangúinibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribúlátus: cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion: that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations, and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Júdica me, Deus, et discérne causam meam de gente non sancta: ab hómine iníquo et dolóso érue me.
verses.eng: Judge me, O God, and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy: deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.

verses.lat: Quia tu es, Deus, fortítudo mea: quare me repulísti? Et quare tristis incédo, dum affígit me inímicus?
verses.eng: For Thou art God, my strength: why hast Thou cast me off? And why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicteth me?

verses.lat: Emítte lucem tuam et veritátem tuam: ipsa me deduxérunt et adduxérunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernácula tua.
verses.eng: Send forth Thy light and Thy truth: they have conducted me and brought me unto Thy holy hill, and into Thy tabernacles.

verses.lat: Et introíbo ad altáre Dei: ad Deum qui lætíficat juventútem meam.
verses.eng: And I will go in to the altar of God: to God who giveth joy to my youth.

verses.lat: Confitebor tibi in cíthara, Deus, Deus meus: quare tristis es, ánima mea? Et quare contúrbas me?
verses.eng: To Thee, O God, my God, I will give praise upon the harp: why art thou sad, O my soul? And why dost thou disquiet me?

verses.lat: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
verses.eng: Hope in God, for I will still give praise to Him: the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ego dixi: In dimídio diérum meórum vadam ad portas ínferi.
verses.eng: I said: In the midst of my days I shall go to the gates of hell.

verses.lat: Quæsívi resíduum annórum meórum.
verses.eng: I sought for the residue of my years.

verses.lat: Dixi: Non vidébo Dóminum Deum in terra vivéntium.
verses.eng: I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Non aspíciam hóminem ultra, et habitátórem quiétis.
verses.eng: I shall behold man no more, nor the dweller in rest.

verses.lat: Generátio mea abláta est, et convólúta est a me, quasi tabernáculum pastórum.
verses.eng: My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, as a shepherd’s tent.

verses.lat: Præcísa est velut a texénte vita mea: dum adhuc ordírer, succídit me: de mane usque ad vésperam fínies me.
verses.eng: My life is cut off as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, He cut me off: from morning even to night Thou wilt make an end of me.

verses.lat: Sperábam usque ad mane; quasi leo, sic contrívit ómnia ossa mea.
verses.eng: I hoped till morning; as a lion, so hath He broken all my bones.

verses.lat: De mane usque ad vésperam fínies me: sicut pullus hirúndinis, sic clamábo; meditábor ut colúmba.
verses.eng: From morning even to night Thou wilt make an end of me: I will cry like a young swallow; I will meditate like a dove.

verses.lat: Attenuáti sunt óculi mei, suspiciéntes in excélsum.
verses.eng: My eyes are weakened, looking upward.

verses.lat: Dómine, vim pátior, respónde pro me. Quid dicam, aut quid respondébit mihi, cum ipse fécerit?
verses.eng: Lord, I suffer violence, answer Thou for me. What shall I say, or what shall He answer me, whereas He Himself hath done it?

verses.lat: Recogitábo tibi omnes annos meos in amaritúdine ánimæ meæ.
verses.eng: I will recount to Thee all my years, in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.lat: Dómine, si sic vívitur, et in tálibus vita spíritus mei, corrípies me et vivificábis me.
verses.eng: O Lord, if man’s life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, Thou shalt correct me, and make me to live.

verses.lat: Ecce in pace amaritúdo mea amarissima: tu autem eruísti ánimam meam, ut non períret: projecisti post tergum tuum ómnia peccáta mea.
verses.eng: Behold, in peace is my bitterness most bitter: but Thou hast delivered my soul, that it should not perish: Thou hast cast all my sins behind Thy back.

verses.lat: Quia non inférnus confitébitur tibi, neque mors laudábit te: non exspectábunt qui descéndunt in lacum veritátem tuam.
verses.eng: For hell shall not confess to Thee, neither shall death praise Thee: nor shall they that go down into the pit look for Thy truth.

verses.lat: Vivens, vivens, ipse confitébitur tibi, sicut et ego hódie: pater fíliis notam fáciet veritátem tuam.
verses.eng: The living, the living, he shall give praise to Thee, as I do this day: the father shall make Thy truth known to the children.

verses.lat: Dómine, salvum me fac, et psalmos nostros cantábimus cunctis diébus vitæ nostræ in domo Dómini.
verses.eng: O Lord, save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ad te levávi óculos meos, qui hábitas in cælis.
verses.eng: To Thee have I lifted up my eyes, who dwellest in heaven.

verses.lat: Ecce sicut óculi servórum in mánibus dominórum suórum,
verses.eng: Behold, as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters,

verses.lat: Sicut óculi ancíllæ in mánibus dóminæ suæ: ita óculi nostri ad Dóminum Deum nostrum, donec misereátur nostri.
verses.eng: As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us.

verses.lat: Miserére nostri, Dómine, miserére nostri: quia multum repléti sumus despectióne.
verses.eng: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for we are greatly filled with contempt.

verses.lat: Quia multum repléta est ánima nostra: oppóbrium abundántibus, et despéctio supérbis.
verses.eng: For our soul is greatly filled: we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israël:
verses.eng: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, let Israel now say:

verses.lat: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, cum exsúrgerent hómines in nos:
verses.eng: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, when men rose up against us:

verses.lat: Forte vivos deglutíssent nos: cum irascéretur furor eórum in nos.
verses.eng: Perhaps they had swallowed us up alive: when their fury was enkindled against us.

verses.lat: Forsítan aqua absorbuísset nos.
verses.eng: Perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

verses.lat: Torréntem pertránsivit ánima nostra: forsítan pertransísset ánima nostra aquam intolérábilem.
verses.eng: Our soul hath passed through a torrent: perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, qui non dedit nos in captiónem déntibus eórum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.

verses.lat: Ánima nostra sicut passer erépta est de láqueo venántium:
verses.eng: Our soul hath been delivered as a sparrow out of the snare of the fowlers:

verses.lat: Láqueus contrítus est, et nos liberáti sumus.
verses.eng: The snare is broken, and we are delivered.

verses.lat: Adjutórium nostrum in nómine Dómini, qui fecit cælum et terram.
verses.eng: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Qui confídunt in Dómino, sicut mons Sion: non commovébitur in ætérnum, qui hábitat in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth in Jerusalem.

verses.lat: Montes in circúitu ejus: et Dóminus in circúitu pópuli sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sæculum.
verses.eng: Mountains are round about it: so the Lord is round about His people, from henceforth now and for ever.

verses.lat: Quia non relínquet Dóminus virgam peccatórum super sortem justórum: ut non exténdant justi ad iniquitátem manus suas.
verses.eng: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just: that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

verses.lat: Bénefac, Dómine, bonis, et rectis corde.
verses.eng: Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, and to the upright of heart.

verses.lat: Declinántes autem in obligatiónes addúcet Dóminus cum operántibus iniquitátem: pax super Israël.
verses.eng: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity: peace upon Israel.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: In converténdo Dóminus captivitátem Sion, facti sumus sicut consoláti.
verses.eng: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, we became like men comforted.

verses.lat: Tunc replétum est gáudio os nostrum: et lingua nostra exsultatióne.
verses.eng: Then was our mouth filled with gladness: and our tongue with joy.

verses.lat: Tunc dicent inter gentes: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
verses.eng: Then shall they say among the Gentiles: The Lord hath done great things for them.

verses.lat: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobiscum: facti sumus lætántes.
verses.eng: The Lord hath done great things for us: we are become joyful.

verses.lat: Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, sicut torrens in Austro.
verses.eng: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as a stream in the south.

verses.lat: Qui séminant in lácrimis, in exsultatióne metent.
verses.eng: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.lat: Eúntes ibant et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
verses.eng: Going, they went and wept, casting their seeds.

verses.lat: Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, portántes manípulos suos.
verses.eng: But coming, they shall come with joyfulness, carrying their sheaves.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dóminus illuminátio mea et salus mea, quem timébo? Dóminus protéctor vitæ meæ, a quo trepidábo?
verses.eng: The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? The Lord is the protector of my life, of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.lat: Dum apprópiant super me nocéntes, ut edant carnes meas: Qui tríbulant me inimíci mei, ipsi infirmáti sunt et cecidérunt.
verses.eng: Whilst the wicked draw near against me, to eat my flesh: My enemies that trouble me, have themselves been weakened and have fallen.

verses.lat: Si consístant advérsum me castra, non timébit cor meum. Si exsúrgat advérsum me prǽlium, in hoc ego sperábo.
verses.eng: If armies in camp should stand together against me, my heart shall not fear. If a battle should rise up against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.lat: Unam pétii a Dómino, hanc requíram: ut inhábitem in domo Dómini ómnibus diébus vitæ meæ: Ut vídeam voluptátem Dómini, et vísitem templum ejus.
verses.eng: One thing I have asked of the Lord, this will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life. That I may see the delight of the Lord, and may visit His temple.

verses.lat: Quóniam abscóndit me in tabernáculo suo: in die malórum protéxit me in abscóndito tabernáculi sui.
verses.eng: For He hath hidden me in His tabernacle; in the day of evils, He hath protected me in the secret place of His tabernacle.

verses.lat: In petra exaltávit me: et nunc exaltávit caput meum super inimícos meos. Circuívi, et immolávi in tabernáculo ejus hóstiam vociferatiónis: cantábo, et psalmum dicam Dómino.
verses.eng: He hath exalted me upon a rock: and now He hath lifted up my head above my enemies. I have gone round, and have offered up in His tabernacle a sacrifice of jubilation: I will sing, and recite a psalm to the Lord.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem meam, qua clamávi ad te: miserére mei, et exáudi me.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, my voice, with which I have cried to Thee: have mercy on me, and hear me.

verses.lat: Tibi dixit cor meum, exquisívit te fácies mea: fáciem tuam, Dómine, requíram.
verses.eng: My heart hath said to Thee: My face hath sought Thee: Thy face, O Lord, will I still seek.

verses.lat: Ne avértas fáciem tuam a me: ne declínes in ira a servo tuo. Adjútor meus esto: ne derelínquas me, neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
verses.eng: Turn not away Thy face from me; decline not in Thy wrath from Thy servant. Be Thou my helper, forsake me not; do not Thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

verses.lat: Quóniam pater meus et mater mea dereliquérunt me: Dóminus autem assúmpsit me.
verses.eng: For my father and my mother have left me: but the Lord hath taken me up.

verses.lat: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, in via tua: et dírige me in sémitam rectam propter inimícos meos.
verses.eng: Set me, O Lord, a law in Thy way, and guide me in the right path, because of my enemies.

verses.lat: Ne tradíderis me in ánimas tribulántium me: quóniam insurrexérunt in me testes iníqui, et mentíta est iníquitas sibi.
verses.eng: Deliver me not over to the will of them that trouble me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and iniquity hath lied to itself.

verses.lat: Credo vidére bona Dómini in terra vivéntium.
verses.eng: I believe to see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.lat: Exspécta Dóminum, viríliter age: et confortétur cor tuum, et sústine Dóminum.
verses.eng: Expect the Lord, do manfully: and let thy heart take courage, and wait thou for the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo, Deus meus, ne síleas a me: nequándo táceas a me, et assimilábor descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: Unto Thee will I cry, O Lord: O my God, be not Thou silent to me: lest if Thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: Exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ dum oro ad te: dum extóllo manus meas ad templum sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication, when I pray to Thee; when I lift up my hands to Thy holy temple.

verses.lat: Ne simul trahas me cum peccatóribus: et cum operántibus iniquitátem ne perdas me: Qui loquúntur pacem cum próximo suo, mala autem in córdibus eórum.
verses.eng: Draw me not away together with the wicked; and with the workers of iniquity destroy me not: Who speak peace with their neighbour, but evils are in their hearts.

verses.lat: Da illis secúndum ópera eórum, et secúndum nequítiam adinventiónum ipsórum. Secúndum ópera mánuum eórum tríbue illis: redde retributiónem eórum ipsis.
verses.eng: Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their inventions. According to the works of their hands give Thou to them: render to them their reward.

verses.lat: Quóniam non intellexérunt ópera Dómini, et in ópera mánuum ejus: déstrues illos, et non ædificábis eos.
verses.eng: Because they have not understood the works of the Lord, and the operations of His hands: Thou shalt destroy them, and shalt not build them up.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus: quóniam exaudívit vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, for He hath heard the voice of my supplication.

verses.lat: Dóminus adjútor meus, et protéctor meus: in ipso sperávit cor meum, et adjútus sum. Et reflóruit caro mea: et ex voluntáte mea confitébor ei.
verses.eng: The Lord is my helper and my protector: in Him hath my heart confided, and I have been helped. And my flesh hath flourished again: and with my will I will give praise to Him.

verses.lat: Dóminus fortitúdo plebis suæ: et protéctor salvatiónum christi sui est.
verses.eng: The Lord is the strength of His people, and the protector of the salvation of His anointed.

verses.lat: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ: et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
verses.eng: Save, O Lord, Thy people, and bless Thy inheritance: and rule them, and exalt them for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exaltábo te, Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me: nec delectásti inimícos meos super me.
verses.eng: I will extol Thee, O Lord, for Thou hast upheld me: and hast not made my enemies to rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Dómine, Deus meus, clamávi ad te, et sanásti me.
verses.eng: O Lord my God, I have cried to Thee, and Thou hast healed me.

verses.lat: Dómine, eduxísti ab inférno ánimam meam: salvásti me a descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: Thou hast brought forth, O Lord, my soul from hell: Thou hast saved me from them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: Psállite Dómino, sancti ejus: et confitémini memóriæ sanctitátis ejus.
verses.eng: Sing to the Lord, O ye His saints: and give praise to the memory of His holiness.

verses.lat: Quóniam ira in indignatióne ejus: et vita in voluntáte ejus. Ad vésperam demorábitur fletus: et ad matutínum lætítia.
verses.eng: For wrath is in His indignation; and life in His good will. In the evening weeping shall have place, and in the morning gladness.

verses.lat: Ego autem dixi in abundántia mea: Non movébor in ætérnum.
verses.eng: And in my abundance I said: I shall never be moved.

verses.lat: Dómine, in voluntáte tua, præstitísti decóri meo virtútem. Avertísti fáciem tuam a me, et factus sum conturbátus.
verses.eng: O Lord, in Thy favour, Thou gavest strength to my beauty. Thou turnedst away Thy face from me, and I became troubled.

verses.lat: Ad te, Dómine, clamábo: et ad Deum meum deprecábor.
verses.eng: To Thee, O Lord, will I cry: and I will make supplication to my God.

verses.lat: Quæ utílitas in sánguine meo, dum descéndo in corruptiónem? Numquid confitébitur tibi pulvis, aut annuntiábit veritátem tuam?
verses.eng: What profit is there in my blood, whilst I go down to corruption? Shall dust confess to Thee, or declare Thy truth?

verses.lat: Audívit Dóminus, et misértus est mei: Dóminus factus est adjútor meus.
verses.eng: The Lord hath heard, and hath had mercy on me: the Lord became my helper.

verses.lat: Convertísti planctum meum in gáudium mihi: conscidísti saccum meum, et circumdedísti me lætítia:
verses.eng: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into joy: Thou hast cut my sackcloth, and hast compassed me with gladness:

verses.lat: Ut cantet tibi glória mea, et non compúngar: Dómine, Deus meus, in ætérnum confitébor tibi.
verses.eng: To the end that my glory may sing to Thee, and I may not regret: O Lord my God, I will give praise to Thee for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: In te, Dómine, sperávi, non confúndar in ætérnum: in justítia tua líbera me.
verses.eng: In Thee, O Lord, have I hoped, let me never be confounded: deliver me in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Inclína ad me aurem tuam, accélera ut éruas me. Esto mihi in Deum protectórem, et in domum refúgii, ut salvum me fácias.
verses.eng: Bow down Thy ear to me: make haste to deliver me. Be Thou unto me a God, a protector, and a house of refuge, to save me.

verses.lat: Quóniam fortitúdo mea et refúgium meum es tu: et propter nomen tuum dedúces me, et enútries me.
verses.eng: For Thou art my strength and my refuge; and for Thy name's sake Thou wilt lead me and nourish me.

verses.lat: Edúces me de láqueo hoc, quem abscondérunt mihi: quóniam tu es protéctor meus.
verses.eng: Thou wilt bring me out of this snare, which they have hidden for me: for Thou art my protector.

verses.lat: In manus tuas comméndo spíritum meum: redemísti me, Dómine, Deus veritátis.
verses.eng: Into Thy hands I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord, the God of truth.

verses.lat: Odísti observántes vanitátes supervácue. Ego autem in Dómino sperávi:
verses.eng: Thou hast hated them that regard vanities to no purpose. But I have hoped in the Lord:

verses.lat: Exsultábo et lætábor in misericórdia tua. Quóniam respexísti humilitátem meam, salvásti de necessitátibus ánimam meam.
verses.eng: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy mercy. For Thou hast regarded my humility, Thou hast saved my soul out of distresses.

verses.lat: Nec conclusísti me in mánibus inimíci: statuísti in loco spatióso pedes meos.
verses.eng: And Thou hast not shut me up in the hands of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a spacious place.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam tríbulor: conturbátus est in ira óculus meus, ánima mea, et venter meus.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with wrath, my soul, and my belly.

verses.lat: Quóniam defécit in dolóre vita mea: et anni mei in gemítibus. Infirmáta est in paupertáte virtus mea: et ossa mea conturbáta sunt.
verses.eng: For my life is wasted with grief: and my years in sighs. My strength is weakened through poverty: and my bones are disturbed.

verses.lat: Super omnes inimícos meos factus sum oppróbrium et vicínis meis valde: et timor notis meis. Qui vidébant me, foras fugérunt a me.
verses.eng: I am become a reproach among all my enemies, and very much to my neighbours: and a fear to my acquaintance. They that saw me without fled from me.

verses.lat: Oblívioni datus sum, tamquam mórtuus a corde. Factus sum tamquam vas pérditum:
verses.eng: I am forgotten as one dead from the heart. I am become as a vessel that is destroyed.

verses.lat: Quóniam audívi vituperatiónem multórum commorántium in circúitu: in eo dum convenírent simul advérsum me, accípere ánimam meam consiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: For I have heard the blame of many that dwell round about: while they assembled together against me, they consulted to take away my life.

verses.lat: Ego autem in te sperávi, Dómine: dixi: Deus meus es tu: in mánibus tuis sortes meæ.
verses.eng: But I have put my trust in Thee, O Lord: I said: Thou art my God. My lots are in Thy hands.

verses.lat: Eripe me de manu inimicórum meórum, et a persequéntibus me.
verses.eng: Deliver me out of the hands of my enemies; and from them that persecute me.

verses.lat: Illústra fáciem tuam super servum tuum, salvum me fac in misericórdia tua: Dómine, non confúndar, quóniam invocávi te.
verses.eng: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; save me in Thy mercy. Let me not be confounded, O Lord, for I have called upon Thee.

verses.lat: Erubéscant ímpii, et deducántur in inférnum: muta fiant lábia dolósa.
verses.eng: Let the wicked be ashamed, and be brought down to hell. Let deceitful lips be made dumb.

verses.lat: Quæ loquúntur advérsus justum iniquitátem: in supérbia, et in abusióne.
verses.eng: Which speak iniquity against the just, with pride and abuse.

verses.lat: Quam magna multitúdo dulcédinis tuæ, Dómine, quam abscondísti timéntibus te! Perfecísti eis, qui sperant in te, in conspéctu filiórum hóminum.
verses.eng: O how great is the multitude of Thy sweetness, O Lord, which Thou hast hidden for them that fear Thee! Which Thou hast wrought for them that hope in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men.

verses.lat: Abscóndes eos in abscóndito faciéi tuæ a conturbatióne hóminum. Próteges eos in tabernáculo tuo a contradictióne linguárum.
verses.eng: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of Thy face, from the disturbance of men. Thou shalt protect them in Thy tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus: quóniam mirificávit misericórdiam suam mihi in civitáte muníta.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord, for He hath shown His wonderful mercy to me in a fortified city.

verses.lat: Ego autem dixi in excéssu mentis meæ: Projéctus sum a fácie oculórum tuórum. Ideo exaudísti vocem oratiónis meæ, dum clamárem ad te.
verses.eng: But I said in the excess of my mind: I am cast away from before Thy eyes. Therefore Thou hast heard the voice of my prayer, when I cried to Thee.

verses.lat: Dilígite Dóminum, omnes sancti ejus: quóniam veritátem requíret Dóminus, et retríbuet abundánter faciéntibus supérbiam.
verses.eng: O love the Lord, all ye His saints: for the Lord will require truth, and will repay them abundantly that act proudly.

verses.lat: Viríliter ágite, et confortétur cor vestrum, omnes qui sperátis in Dómino.
verses.eng: Do ye manfully, and let your heart be strengthened, all ye that hope in the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Júdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, expúgna impugnántes me.
verses.eng: Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me: overthrow them that fight against me.

verses.lat: Apprehénde arma et scutum: et exsúrge in adjutórium mihi.
verses.eng: Take hold of arms and shield: and rise up to help me.

verses.lat: Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos qui persequúntur me: dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.
verses.eng: Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul: I am thy salvation.

verses.lat: Confundántur et revereántur, quæréntes ánimam meam. Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur cogitántes mihi mala.
verses.eng: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and be confounded that devise evil against me.

verses.lat: Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.
verses.eng: Let them become as dust before the wind: and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.

verses.lat: Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.
verses.eng: Let their way become dark and slippery: and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

verses.lat: Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.
verses.eng: For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: without cause they have upbraided my soul.

verses.lat: Véniat illi láqueus quem ignórat: et cáptio quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.
verses.eng: Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him: and let the net which he hath hidden catch him: and into that very snare let him fall.

verses.lat: Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: et delectábitur super salutári suo.
verses.eng: But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; and shall be delighted in His salvation.

verses.lat: Ómnia ossa mea dicent: Dómine, quis símilis tibi? Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum ejus: egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.
verses.eng: All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like to Thee? Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; the needy and the poor from them that strip him.

verses.lat: Surgéntes testes iníqui, quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.
verses.eng: Unjust witnesses rising up, asked me things I knew not.

verses.lat: Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.
verses.eng: They repaid me evil for good: to the depriving me of my soul.

verses.lat: Ego autem, cum mihi molésti essent, induébar cilício. Humiliábam in jejúnio ánimam meam: et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.
verses.eng: But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, I was clothed with haircloth. I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

verses.lat: Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum sic compla­cébam: quasi lugens et contristátus sic humiliábar.
verses.eng: As a neighbour, and as an own brother, so did I please: as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

verses.lat: Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.
verses.eng: But they rejoiced against me, and came together: scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

verses.lat: Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: fremuérunt super me déntibus suis.
verses.eng: They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.lat: Dómine, quando respícies? Restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.
verses.eng: Lord, when wilt Thou look upon me? Rescue my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, in pópulo gravi laudábo te.
verses.eng: I will give thanks to Thee in a great church; I will praise Thee in a strong people.

verses.lat: Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.
verses.eng: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.

verses.lat: Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.
verses.eng: For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.

verses.lat: Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.
verses.eng: And they opened their mouth wide against me; they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

verses.lat: Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: Dómine, ne discédas a me.
verses.eng: Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not Thou silent: O Lord, depart not from me.

verses.lat: Exsúrge et inténde judício meo: Deus meus, et Dóminus meus, in causam meam.
verses.eng: Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: to my cause, my God, and my Lord.

verses.lat: Júdica me secúndum justítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, et non supergáudeant mihi.
verses.eng: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy justice, and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.
verses.eng: Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.

verses.lat: Erubéscant et revereántur simul, qui gratulántur malis meis. Induántur confusióne et reveréntia, qui magna loquúntur super me.
verses.eng: Let them blush and be ashamed together, who rejoice at my evils. Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, who speak great things against me.

verses.lat: Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt justítiam meam: et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus, qui volunt pacem servi ejus.
verses.eng: Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of His servant.

verses.lat: Et lingua mea meditábitur justítiam tuam, tota die laudem tuam.
verses.eng: And my tongue shall meditate Thy justice, Thy praise all the day long.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Noli æmulári in malignántibus: neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
verses.eng: Be not emulous of evildoers; nor envy them that work iniquity.

verses.lat: Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
verses.eng: For they shall shortly wither away as grass, and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

verses.lat: Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis ejus.
verses.eng: Trust in the Lord, and do good, and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

verses.lat: Delectáre in Dómino: et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
verses.eng: Delight in the Lord, and He will give thee the requests of thy heart.

verses.lat: Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: et ipse fáciet.
verses.eng: Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in Him, and He will do it.

verses.lat: Et edúcet quasi lumen justítiam tuam: et judícium tuum tamquam merídiem: súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.
verses.eng: And He will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday. Be subject to the Lord and pray to Him.

verses.lat: Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: in hómine faciénte injustítias.
verses.eng: Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

verses.lat: Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: noli æmulári ut malignéris.
verses.eng: Cease from anger, and leave rage; have no emulation to do evil.

verses.lat: Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
verses.eng: For evildoers shall be cut off: but they that wait upon the Lord shall inherit the land.

verses.lat: Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: et quæres locum ejus, et non invénies.
verses.eng: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

verses.lat: Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.
verses.eng: But the meek shall inherit the land, and shall delight in abundance of peace.

verses.lat: Observábit peccátor justum: et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
verses.eng: The sinner shall watch the just man: and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem irridébit eum: quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies ejus.
verses.eng: But the Lord shall laugh at him: for He foreseeth that his day shall come.

verses.lat: Gládium evaginavérunt peccatóres: intendérunt arcum suum, Ut dejíciant páuperem et ínopem: ut trucídent rectos corde.
verses.eng: The wicked have drawn out the sword: they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill the upright of heart.

verses.lat: Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: et arcus eórum confringátur.
verses.eng: Let their sword enter into their own hearts, and let their bow be broken.

verses.lat: Mélius est módicum justo, super divítias peccatórum multas.
verses.eng: Better is a little to the just, than the great riches of the wicked.

verses.lat: Quóniam bráchia peccatórum conteréntur: confírmat autem justos Dóminus.
verses.eng: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

verses.lat: Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
verses.eng: The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled; and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.lat: Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: quia peccatóres períbunt.
verses.eng: They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled: because the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Inimíci vero Dómini, mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.
verses.eng: But the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.

verses.lat: Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: justus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
verses.eng: The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; but the just showeth mercy and shall give.

verses.lat: Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.
verses.eng: For such as bless Him shall inherit the land: but such as curse Him shall perish.

verses.lat: Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: et viam ejus volet.
verses.eng: The steps of a man shall be directed by the Lord: and He shall like well his way.

verses.lat: Cum cecíderit, non collidétur: quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.
verses.eng: When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, for the Lord putteth His hand under him.

verses.lat: Júnior fui, étenim sénui: et non vidi justum derelíctum, nec semen ejus quærens panem.
verses.eng: I have been young, and now am old; and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

verses.lat: Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
verses.eng: He showeth mercy, and lendeth all the day long; and his seed shall be in blessing.

verses.lat: Declína a malo, et fac bonum: et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Decline from evil and do good, and dwell for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Quia Dóminus amat judícium, et non derelínquet sanctos suos: in ætérnum conservabúntur. Injústi puniéntur: et semen impiórum períbit.
verses.eng: For the Lord loveth judgment, and will not forsake His saints: they shall be preserved for ever. The unjust shall be punished, and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Justi autem hereditábunt terram: et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.
verses.eng: But the just shall inherit the land, and shall dwell therein for evermore.

verses.lat: Os justi meditábitur sapiéntiam: et lingua ejus loquétur judícium.
verses.eng: The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: and his tongue shall speak judgment.

verses.lat: Lex Dei ejus in corde ipsíus: et non supplantabúntur gressus ejus.
verses.eng: The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps shall not be supplanted.

verses.lat: Consíderat peccátor justum: et quærit mortificáre eum.
verses.eng: The wicked watcheth the just man, and seeketh to put him to death.

verses.lat: Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus ejus: nec damnábit eum cum judicábitur illi.
verses.eng: But the Lord will not leave him in his hands; nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

verses.lat: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam ejus: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: cum períerint peccatóres, vidébis.
verses.eng: Expect the Lord and keep His way: and He will exalt thee to inherit the land: when the sinners shall perish thou shalt see.

verses.lat: Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
verses.eng: I have seen the wicked highly exalted, and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

verses.lat: Et transívi, et ecce non erat: et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus ejus.
verses.eng: And I passed by, and lo, he was not: and I sought him and his place was not found.

verses.lat: Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
verses.eng: Keep innocence, and behold justice: for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

verses.lat: Injústi autem disperíbunt simul: relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
verses.eng: But the unjust shall be destroyed together: the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

verses.lat: Salus autem justórum a Dómino: et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
verses.eng: But the salvation of the just is from the Lord, and He is their protector in the time of trouble.

verses.lat: Et adjuvábit eos Dóminus, et liberábit eos: et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.
verses.eng: And the Lord will help them and deliver them: and He will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in Him.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, neque in ira tua corrípias me.
verses.eng: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy indignation, nor chastise me in Thy wrath.

verses.lat: Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
verses.eng: For Thy arrows are fastened in me: and Thy hand hath been strong upon me.

verses.lat: Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
verses.eng: There is no health in my flesh, because of Thy wrath: there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
verses.eng: For my iniquities are gone over my head: and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

verses.lat: Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.
verses.eng: My sores are putrified and corrupted, because of my foolishness.

verses.lat: Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
verses.eng: I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: I walked sorrowful all the day long.

verses.lat: Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: et non est sánitas in carne mea.
verses.eng: For my loins are filled with illusions; and there is no health in my flesh.

verses.lat: Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
verses.eng: I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: I roared with the groaning of my heart.

verses.lat: Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
verses.eng: Lord, all my desire is before Thee, and my groaning is not hidden from Thee.

verses.lat: Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
verses.eng: My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

verses.lat: Amíci mei et próximi mei advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt. Et qui juxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
verses.eng: My friends and my neighbours have drawn near, and stood against me. And they that were near me stood afar off: and they that sought my soul used violence.

verses.lat: Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: et dolos tota die meditabántur.
verses.eng: And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, and studied deceits all the day long.

verses.lat: Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
verses.eng: But I, as a deaf man, heard not: and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

verses.lat: Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
verses.eng: And I became as a man that heareth not: and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

verses.lat: Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: tu exáudies, Dómine, Deus meus.
verses.eng: For in Thee, O Lord, have I hoped: Thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

verses.lat: Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
verses.eng: For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

verses.lat: Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
verses.eng: For I am ready for scourges: and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
verses.eng: For I will declare my iniquity: and I will think for my sin.

verses.lat: Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
verses.eng: But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.lat: Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
verses.eng: They that render evil for good, have detracted me, because I followed goodness.

verses.lat: Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: ne discésseris a me.
verses.eng: Forsake me not, O Lord my God: do not Thou depart from me.

verses.lat: Inténde in adjutórium meum, Dómine, Deus salútis meæ.
verses.eng: Attend unto my help, O Lord, the God of my salvation.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dixi: Custódiam vias meas: ut non delínquam in lingua mea. Pósui ori meo custódiam, cum consísteret peccátor advérsum me.
verses.eng: I said: I will take heed to my ways: that I sin not with my tongue. I set a guard to my mouth, when the sinner stood against me.

verses.lat: Obmútui, et humiliátus sum, et sílui a bonis: et dolor meus renovátus est.
verses.eng: I was dumb, and was humbled, and kept silence from good things: and my sorrow was renewed.

verses.lat: Concáluit cor meum intra me: et in meditatióne mea exardéscet ignis.
verses.eng: My heart grew hot within me: and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.

verses.lat: Locútus sum in lingua mea: Notum fac mihi, Dómine, finem meum. Et númerum diérum meórum quis est: ut sciam quid desit mihi.
verses.eng: I spoke with my tongue: O Lord, make me know my end. And what is the number of my days: that I may know what is wanting to me.

verses.lat: Ecce mensurábiles posuísti dies meos: et substántia mea tamquam níhilum ante te. Verúmtamen univérsa vánitas, omnis homo vivens.
verses.eng: Behold Thou hast made my days measurable: and my substance is as nothing before Thee. And indeed all things are vanity: every man living.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen in imágine pertránsit homo: sed et frustra conturbátur. Thesaurízat: et ignórat cui congregábit ea.
verses.eng: Surely man passeth as an image: yea, and he is disquieted in vain. He storeth up: and he knoweth not for whom he shall gather these things.

verses.lat: Et nunc quæ est exspectátio mea? nonne Dóminus? et substántia mea apud te est.
verses.eng: And now what is my hope? Is it not the Lord? And my substance is with Thee.

verses.lat: Ab ómnibus iniquitátibus meis érue me: oppróbrium insipiénti dedísti me.
verses.eng: Deliver Thou me from all my iniquities: Thou hast made me a reproach to the fool.

verses.lat: Obmútui, et non apérui os meum, quóniam tu fecísti: ámove a me plagas tuas.
verses.eng: I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because Thou hast done it. Remove Thy scourges from me.

verses.lat: A fortitúdine manus tuæ ego deféci in increpatió­nibus: propter iniquitátem corripuísti hóminem. Et tabéscere fecísti sicut aráneam ánimam ejus: verúmtamen vane conturbátur omnis homo.
verses.eng: The strength of Thy hand hath made me faint in rebukes: Thou hast corrected man for iniquity. And Thou hast made his soul to waste away like a spider: surely in vain is any man disquieted.

verses.lat: Exáudi oratiónem meam, Dómine, et deprecatiónem meam: áuribus pércipe lácrimas meas. Ne síleas: quóniam ádvena ego sum apud te, et peregrínus, sicut omnes patres mei.
verses.eng: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and my supplication: give ear to my tears. Be not silent: for I am a stranger with Thee, and a sojourner as all my fathers were.

verses.lat: Remítte mihi, ut refrígerer priúsquam ábeam, et ámplius non ero.
verses.eng: O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Beátus qui intéllegit super egénum et páuperem: in die mala liberábit eum Dóminus.
verses.eng: Blessed is he that understandeth concerning the needy and the poor: the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.

verses.lat: Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra: et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.

verses.lat: Dóminus opem ferat illi super lectum dolóris ejus: univérsum stratum ejus versásti in infirmitáte ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord help him on his bed of sorrow: Thou hast turned all his couch in his sickness.

verses.lat: Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei: sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
verses.eng: I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me: heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.

verses.lat: Inimíci mei dixérunt mala mihi: Quando moriétur, et períbit nomen ejus?
verses.eng: My enemies have spoken evils against me: When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.lat: Et si ingrediebátur ut vidéret, vana loquebátur, cor ejus congregávit iniquitátem sibi. Egredie­bátur foras, et loquebátur in idípsum.
verses.eng: And if he came in to see me, he spoke vain things: his heart gathered together iniquity to itself. He went out and spoke to the same purpose.

verses.lat: Advérsum me susurrábant omnes inimíci mei: advérsum me cogitábant mala mihi.
verses.eng: All my enemies whispered together against me: they devised evils to me.

verses.lat: Verbum iníquum constituérunt advérsum me: Numquid qui dormit non adjíciet ut resúrgat?
verses.eng: They determined against me an unjust word: shall he that sleepeth rise again no more?

verses.lat: Etenim homo pacis meæ, in quo sperávi: qui edébat panes meos, magnificávit super me supplanta­tiónem.
verses.eng: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, hath greatly supplanted me.

verses.lat: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére mei, et resúscita me: et retríbuam eis.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up again: and I will requite them.

verses.lat: In hoc cognóvi quóniam voluísti me: quóniam non gaudébit inimícus meus super me.
verses.eng: By this I know that Thou hast had a good will for me: because my enemy shall not rejoice over me.

verses.lat: Me autem propter innocéntiam suscepísti: et confirmásti me in conspéctu tuo in ætérnum.
verses.eng: But Thou hast upheld me by reason of my innocence: and hast established me in Thy sight for ever.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum. Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. So be it. So be it.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam. Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy. And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua: et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: exáudi me in tua justítia.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in Thy truth: hear me in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Et non intres in judícium cum servo tuo: quia non justificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
verses.eng: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant: for in Thy sight no man living shall be justified.

verses.lat: Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: humiliávit in terra vitam meam. Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi:
verses.eng: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: he hath brought down my life to the earth. He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old:

verses.lat: et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
verses.eng: and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

verses.lat: Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
verses.eng: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all Thy works: I meditated upon the works of Thy hands.

verses.lat: Expándi manus meas ad te: ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
verses.eng: I stretched forth my hands to Thee: my soul is as earth without water unto Thee.

verses.lat: Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: defécit spíritus meus. Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit hath fainted away. Turn not away Thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: quia in te sperávi. Notam fac mihi viam in qua ámbulem: quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
verses.eng: Cause me to hear Thy mercy in the morning; for in Thee have I hoped. Make the way known to me wherein I should walk: for I have lifted up my soul to Thee.

verses.lat: Eripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
verses.eng: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to Thee have I fled: teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God.

verses.lat: Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua. Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam:
verses.eng: Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: for Thy name's sake, O Lord, Thou wilt quicken me in Thy justice. Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble:

verses.lat: et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos. Et perdes omnes qui tríbulant ánimam meam: quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
verses.eng: and in Thy mercy Thou wilt destroy my enemies. And Thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: for I am Thy servant.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, audívi auditiónem tuam, et tímui. Dómine, opus tuum, in médio annórum vivífica illud.
verses.eng: O Lord, I have heard Thy hearing, and was afraid. O Lord, Thy work, in the midst of the years bring it to life.

verses.lat: In médio annórum notum fácies: cum irátus fúeris, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
verses.eng: In the midst of the years Thou shalt make it known: when Thou art angry, Thou wilt remember mercy.

verses.lat: Deus ab Austro véniet, et Sanctus de monte Pharan. Opéruit cælos glória ejus: et laudis ejus plena est terra.
verses.eng: God will come from the south, and the Holy One from mount Pharan. His glory covered the heavens: and the earth is full of His praise.

verses.lat: Splendor ejus ut lux erit: córnua in mánibus ejus. Ibi abscóndita est fortitúdo ejus:
verses.eng: His brightness shall be as the light; horns are in His hands: There is His strength hid:

verses.lat: ante fáciem ejus ibit mors. Et egrediétur diábolus ante pedes ejus.
verses.eng: Death shall go before His face. And the devil shall go forth before His feet.

verses.lat: Stetit, et mensus est terram. Aspéxit, et dissólvit gentes: et contríti sunt montes sǽculi. Incurváti sunt colles mundi, ab itinéribus æternitátis ejus.
verses.eng: He stood and measured the earth. He beheld, and melted the nations: and the ancient mountains were crushed to pieces. The hills of the world were bowed down by the journeys of His eternity.

verses.lat: Pro iniquitáte vidi tentória Æthíopiæ, turbabúntur pelles terræ Mádian.
verses.eng: I saw the tents of Ethiopia for their iniquity, the curtains of the land of Madian shall be troubled.

verses.lat: Numquid in flumínibus irátus es, Dómine? aut in flumínibus furor tuus? vel in mari indignátio tua? Qui ascéndes super equos tuos: et quadrígæ tuæ salvátio.
verses.eng: Wast Thou angry, O Lord, with the rivers? or was Thy wrath upon the rivers? or Thy indignation in the sea? Who wilt ride upon Thy horses: and Thy chariots are salvation.

verses.lat: Súscitans suscitábis arcum tuum: juraménta tríbubus quæ locútus es. Flúvios scindes terræ:
verses.eng: Thou wilt surely take up Thy bow: according to the oaths which Thou hast spoken to the tribes. Thou wilt divide the rivers of the earth.

verses.lat: vidérunt te, et doluérunt montes: gurges aquárum tránsiit. Dedit abýssus vocem suam: altitúdo manus suas levávit.
verses.eng: The mountains saw Thee, and were grieved: the great body of waters passed away. The deep put forth its voice: the deep lifted up its hands.

verses.lat: Sol et luna stetérunt in habitáculo suo, in luce sagittárum tuárum, ibunt in splendóre fulgurántis hastæ tuæ.
verses.eng: The sun and the moon stood still in their habitation, in the light of Thy arrows, they shall go in the brightness of Thy glittering spear.

verses.lat: In frémitu conculcábis terram: in furóre obstupefácies gentes.
verses.eng: In Thy anger Thou wilt tread the earth under foot: in Thy wrath Thou wilt astonish the nations.

verses.lat: Egréssus es in salútem pópuli tui: in salútem cum christo tuo. Percussísti caput de domo ímpii: denudásti fundaméntum ejus usque ad collum.
verses.eng: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of Thy people: for salvation with Thy Christ. Thou struckest the head of the house of the wicked: thou hast laid bare his foundation even to the neck.

verses.lat: Maledixísti sceptris ejus, cápiti bellatórum ejus, veniéntibus ut turbo ad dispergéndum me. Exsultátio eórum sicut ejus, qui dévorat páuperem in abscóndito.
verses.eng: Thou hast cursed his sceptres, the head of his warriors, them that came out as a whirlwind to scatter me. Their joy was like that of him that devoureth the poor man in secret.

verses.lat: Viam fecísti in mari equis tuis, in luto aquárum multárum.
verses.eng: Thou madest a way in the sea for Thy horses, in the mud of many waters.

verses.lat: Audívi, et conturbátus est venter meus: a voce contremuérunt lábia mea. Ingrediátur putrédo in óssibus meis, et subter me scáteat.
verses.eng: I have heard and my bowels were troubled: my lips trembled at the voice. Let rottenness enter into my bones, and swarm under me.

verses.lat: Ut requiéscam in die tribulatiónis: ut ascéndam ad pópulum accínctum nostrum.
verses.eng: That I may rest in the day of tribulation: that I may go up to our people that are girded.

verses.lat: Ficus enim non florébit: et non erit germen in víneis. Mentiétur opus olívæ: et arva non ádferent cibum. Abscindétur de ovíli pecus: et non erit arméntum in præsépibus.
verses.eng: For the fig tree shall not blossom: and there shall be no spring in the vines. The labour of the olive tree shall fail: and the fields shall yield no food. The flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls.

verses.lat: Ego autem in Dómino gaudébo: et exsultábo in Deo Jesu meo.
verses.eng: But I will rejoice in the Lord: and I will joy in God my Jesus.

verses.lat: Deus Dóminus fortitúdo mea: et ponet pedes meos quasi cervórum. Et super excélsa mea dedúcet me victor in psalmis canéntem.
verses.eng: The Lord God is my strength: and He will make my feet like the feet of harts: and He the conqueror will lead me upon my high places singing psalms.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: quóniam audísti verba oris mei. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi:
verses.eng: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: for Thou hast heard the words of my mouth. I will sing praise to Thee in the sight of the Angels:

verses.lat: adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo. Super misericórdia tua et veritáte tua: quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
verses.eng: I will worship towards Thy holy temple, and I will give glory to Thy name. For Thy mercy, and for Thy truth: for Thou hast magnified Thy holy name above all.

verses.lat: In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
verses.eng: In what day soever I shall call upon Thee, hear me: Thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
verses.eng: May all the kings of the earth give glory to Thee: for they have heard all the words of Thy mouth:

verses.lat: Et cantent in viis Dómini: quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
verses.eng: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.lat: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: et alta a longe cognóscit.
verses.eng: For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: and the high He knoweth afar off.

verses.lat: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
verses.eng: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, Thou wilt quicken me: and Thou hast stretched forth Thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and Thy right hand hath saved me.

verses.lat: Dóminus retríbuet pro me: Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
verses.eng: The Lord will repay for me: Thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of Thy hands.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: tu cognovísti sessiónem meam et resurrectiónem meam.
verses.eng: Lord, Thou hast proved me, and known me: Thou hast known my sitting down and my rising up.

verses.lat: Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: sémitam meam et funículum meum investigásti.
verses.eng: Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: my path and my line Thou hast searched out.

verses.lat: Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
verses.eng: And Thou hast foreseen all my ways: for there is no speech in my tongue.

verses.lat: Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima et antíqua: tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.
verses.eng: Behold, O Lord, Thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: Thou hast formed me, and hast laid Thy hand upon me.

verses.lat: Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.
verses.eng: Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: it is high, and I cannot reach to it.

verses.lat: Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?
verses.eng: Whither shall I go from Thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from Thy face?

verses.lat: Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: si descéndero in inférnum, ades.
verses.eng: If I ascend into heaven, Thou art there: if I descend into hell, Thou art present.

verses.lat: Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, et habitávero in extrémis maris:
verses.eng: If I take my wings early in the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:

verses.lat: Etenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: et tenébit me déxtera tua.
verses.eng: Even there also shall Thy hand lead me: and Thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.lat: Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.
verses.eng: And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: and night shall be my light in my pleasures.

verses.lat: Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: sicut ténebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus.
verses.eng: But darkness shall not be dark to Thee, and night shall be light as the day: the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to Thee.

verses.lat: Quia tu possedísti renes meos: suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.
verses.eng: For Thou hast possessed my reins: Thou hast protected me from my mother's womb.

verses.lat: Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: mirabília ópera tua, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
verses.eng: I will praise Thee, for Thou art fearfully magnified: wonderful are Thy works, and my soul knoweth right well.

verses.lat: Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.
verses.eng: My bone is not hidden from Thee, which Thou hast made in secret: and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.
verses.eng: Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, and in Thy book all shall be written: days shall be formed, and no one in them.

verses.lat: Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
verses.eng: But to me Thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

verses.lat: Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.
verses.eng: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: I rose up, and am still with Thee.

verses.lat: Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: viri sánguinum, declináte a me.
verses.eng: If Thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: ye men of blood, depart from me.

verses.lat: Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.
verses.eng: Because you say in thought: They shall receive Thy cities in vain.

verses.lat: Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?
verses.eng: Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated Thee: and pined away because of Thy enemies?

verses.lat: Perfécto ódio óderam illos: et inimíci facti sunt mihi.
verses.eng: I have hated them with a perfect hatred: and they are become enemies to me.

verses.lat: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.
verses.eng: Prove me, O God, and know my heart: examine me, and know my paths.

verses.lat: Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: et deduc me in via ætérna.
verses.eng: And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: and lead me in the eternal way.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Eripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo: a viro iníquo éripe me.
verses.eng: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: rescue me from the unjust man.

verses.lat: Qui cogitavérunt iniquitátes in corde: tota die constituébant prǽlia.
verses.eng: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: all the day long they designed battles.

verses.lat: Acuérunt linguas suas sicut serpéntis: venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
verses.eng: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: the venom of asps is under their lips.

verses.lat: Custódi me, Dómine, de manu peccatóris: et ab homínibus iníquis éripe me. Qui cogitavérunt supplantáre gressus meos:
verses.eng: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the wicked: and from unjust men deliver me. Who have proposed to supplant my steps.

verses.lat: abscondérunt supérbi láqueum mihi: Et funes extendérunt in láqueum: juxta iter scándalum posuérunt mihi.
verses.eng: The proud have hidden a net for me. And they have stretched out cords for a snare: they have laid for me a stumbling block by the wayside.

verses.lat: Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu: exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.

verses.lat: Dómine, Dómine, virtus salútis meæ: obumbrásti super caput meum in die belli.
verses.eng: O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: Thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.

verses.lat: Ne tradas me, Dómine, a desidério meo peccatóri: cogitavérunt contra me, ne derelínquas me, ne forte exalténtur.
verses.eng: Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: they have plotted against me; do not Thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.

verses.lat: Caput circúitus eórum: labor labiórum ipsórum opériet eos.
verses.eng: The head of them compassing me about: the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.

verses.lat: Cadent super eos carbónes, in ignem dejícies eos: in misériis non subsístent.
verses.eng: Burning coals shall fall upon them; Thou wilt cast them down into the fire: in miseries they shall not be able to stand.

verses.lat: Vir linguósus non dirigétur in terra: virum injústum mala cápient in intéritu.
verses.eng: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.

verses.lat: Cognóvi quia fáciet Dóminus judícium ínopis: et vindíctam páuperum.
verses.eng: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, and will revenge the poor.

verses.lat: Verúmtamen justi confitebúntur nómini tuo: et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
verses.eng: But as for the just, they shall give glory to Thy name: and the upright shall dwell with Thy countenance.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: et clamor meus ad te véniat.
verses.eng: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: and let my cry come to Thee.

verses.lat: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: in quacúmque die tríbulor, inclína ad me aurem tuam. In quacúmque die invocávero te, velóciter exáudi me.
verses.eng: Turn not away Thy face from me: in the day when I am in trouble, incline Thy ear to me. In what day soever I shall call upon Thee, hear me speedily.

verses.lat: Quia defecérunt sicut fumus dies mei: et ossa mea sicut crémium aruérunt.
verses.eng: For my days are vanished like smoke: and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.

verses.lat: Percússus sum ut fænum, et áruit cor meum: quia oblítus sum comédere panem meum.
verses.eng: I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: because I forgot to eat my bread.

verses.lat: A voce gémitus mei adhǽsit os meum carni meæ.
verses.eng: Through the voice of my groaning, my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.

verses.lat: Símilis factus sum pellicáno solitúdinis: factus sum sicut nycticórax in domicílio.
verses.eng: I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: I am like a night raven in the house.

verses.lat: Vigilávi, et factus sum sicut passer solitárius in tecto.
verses.eng: I have watched, and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.

verses.lat: Tota die exprobrábant mihi inimíci mei: et qui laudábant me, advérsum me jurábant.
verses.eng: All the day long my enemies reproached me: and they that praised me did swear against me.

verses.lat: Quia cínerem tamquam panem manducábam, et potum meum cum fletu miscébam.
verses.eng: For I did eat ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.

verses.lat: A fácie iræ et indignatiónis tuæ: quia élevans allisísti me.
verses.eng: Because of Thy anger and indignation: for having lifted me up Thou hast thrown me down.

verses.lat: Dies mei sicut umbra declinavérunt: et ego sicut fænum árui.
verses.eng: My days have declined like a shadow, and I am withered like grass.

verses.lat: Tu autem, Dómine, in ætérnum pérmanes: et memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
verses.eng: But Thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: and Thy memorial to all generations.

verses.lat: Tu exsúrgens miseréberis Sion: quia tempus miseréndi ejus, quia venit tempus.
verses.eng: Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.

verses.lat: Quóniam placuérunt servis tuis lápides ejus: et terræ ejus miserebúntur.
verses.eng: For the stones thereof have pleased Thy servants: and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.

verses.lat: Et timébunt gentes nomen tuum, Dómine, et omnes reges terræ glóriam tuam.
verses.eng: And the Gentiles shall fear Thy name, O Lord, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory.

verses.lat: Quia ædificávit Dóminus Sion: et vidébitur in glória sua.
verses.eng: For the Lord hath built up Sion: and He shall be seen in His glory.

verses.lat: Respéxit in oratiónem humílium: et non sprevit precem eórum.
verses.eng: He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: and He hath not despised their petition.

verses.lat: Scribántur hæc in generatióne áltera: et pópulus qui creábitur laudábit Dóminum:
