verses.eng: Let these things be written unto another generation: and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:

verses.lat: Quia prospéxit de excélso sancto suo: Dóminus de cælo in terram aspéxit:
verses.eng: Because He hath looked forth from His high sanctuary: from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.

verses.lat: Ut audíret gémitus compeditórum: ut sólveret fílios interemptórum:
verses.eng: That He might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: that He might release the children of the slain:

verses.lat: Ut annúntient in Sion nomen Dómini: et laudem ejus in Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: and His praise in Jerusalem.

verses.lat: In conveniéndo pópulos in unum, et reges, ut sérviant Dómino.
verses.eng: When the people assemble together, and kings, to serve the Lord.

verses.lat: Respóndit ei in via virtútis suæ: Paucitátem diérum meórum núntia mihi.
verses.eng: He answered him in the way of his strength: Declare unto me the fewness of my days.

verses.lat: Ne révoces me in dimídio diérum meórum: in generatiónem et generatiónem anni tui.
verses.eng: Call me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are unto generation and generation.

verses.lat: Inítio tu, Dómine, terram fundásti: et ópera mánuum tuárum sunt cæli.
verses.eng: In the beginning, O Lord, Thou foundedst the earth: and the heavens are the works of Thy hands.

verses.lat: Ipsi períbunt, tu autem pérmanes: et omnes sicut vestiméntum veteráscent. Et sicut opertórium mutábis eos, et mutabúntur:
verses.eng: They shall perish but Thou remainest: and all of them shall grow old like a garment. And as a vesture Thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.lat: tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non defícient.
verses.eng: but Thou art always the selfsame, and Thy years shall not fail.

verses.lat: Fílii servórum tuórum habitábunt: et semen eórum in sǽculum dirigétur.
verses.eng: The children of Thy servants shall continue: and their seed shall be directed for ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: et ómnia quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto ejus.
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and let all that is within me bless His holy name.

verses.lat: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: et noli oblivisci omnes retributiónes ejus.
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and never forget all He hath done for thee.

verses.lat: Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
verses.eng: Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: who healeth all thy diseases.

verses.lat: Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
verses.eng: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

verses.lat: Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: renovábitur ut áquilæ juvéntus tua.
verses.eng: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle's.

verses.lat: Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: et judícium ómnibus injúriam patiéntibus.
verses.eng: The Lord doth mercies, and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

verses.lat: Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
verses.eng: He hath made His ways known to Moses, His wills to the children of Israel.

verses.lat: Miserátor et miséricors Dóminus: longánimis et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: The Lord is compassionate and merciful: longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: Non in perpétuum irascétur: neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
verses.eng: He will not always be angry: nor will He threaten for ever.

verses.lat: Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
verses.eng: He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.lat: Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
verses.eng: For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: He hath strengthened His mercy towards them that fear Him.

verses.lat: Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
verses.eng: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He removed our iniquities from us.

verses.lat: Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
verses.eng: As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear Him: for He knoweth our frame.

verses.lat: Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: homo, sicut fænum dies ejus, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
verses.eng: He remembereth that we are dust: man's days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

verses.lat: Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
verses.eng: For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: and he shall know his place no more.

verses.lat: Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum. Et justítia illíus in fílios filiórum,
verses.eng: But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity and unto eternity upon them that fear Him. And His justice unto children's children,

verses.lat: his qui servant testaméntum ejus: Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus ad faciéndum ea.
verses.eng: to such as keep His covenant, and are mindful of His commandments to do them.

verses.lat: Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
verses.eng: The Lord hath prepared His throne in heaven: and His kingdom shall rule over all.

verses.lat: Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli ejus: poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum ejus.
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, all ye His Angels: you that are mighty in strength, and execute His word, hearkening to the voice of His orders.

verses.lat: Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes ejus: minístri ejus, qui fácitis voluntátem ejus.
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, all ye His hosts: you ministers of His that do His will.

verses.lat: Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera ejus: in omni loco dominatiónis ejus, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, all His works: in every place of His dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter. Confessiónem et decórem induísti:
verses.eng: Bless the Lord, O my soul: O Lord my God, Thou art exceedingly great. Thou hast put on praise and beauty:

verses.lat: amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto. Exténdens cælum sicut pellem:
verses.eng: and art clothed with light as with a garment. Who stretchest out the heaven like a pavilion:

verses.lat: qui tegis aquis superióra ejus. Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.
verses.eng: who coverest the higher rooms thereof with water. Who makest the clouds Thy chariot: who walkest upon the wings of the winds.

verses.lat: Qui facis ángelos tuos spíritus: et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.
verses.eng: Who makest Thy angels spirits: and Thy ministers a burning fire.

verses.lat: Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Who hast founded the earth upon its own bases: it shall not be moved for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Abýssus sicut vestiméntum amíctus ejus: super montes stabunt aquæ.
verses.eng: The deep like a garment is its clothing: above the mountains shall the waters stand.

verses.lat: Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.
verses.eng: At Thy rebuke they shall flee: at the voice of Thy thunder they shall fear.

verses.lat: Ascéndunt montes, et descéndunt campi in locum quem fundásti eis.
verses.eng: The mountains ascend, and the plains descend into the place which Thou hast founded for them.

verses.lat: Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: neque converténtur operíre terram.
verses.eng: Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass over; neither shall they return to cover the earth.

verses.lat: Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.
verses.eng: Thou sendest forth springs in the vales: between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.

verses.lat: Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.
verses.eng: All the beasts of the field shall drink: the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.

verses.lat: Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: de médio petrárum dabunt voces.
verses.eng: Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.

verses.lat: Rigans montes de superióribus suis: de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:
verses.eng: Thou waterest the hills from Thy upper rooms: the earth shall be filled with the fruit of Thy works:

verses.lat: Prodúcens fænum juméntis, et herbam servitúti hóminum: Ut edúcas panem de terra:
verses.eng: Bringing forth grass for cattle, and herb for the service of men. That Thou mayst bring bread out of the earth:

verses.lat: et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis: Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: et panis cor hóminis confírmet.
verses.eng: and that wine may cheer the heart of man. That he may make the face cheerful with oil: and that bread may strengthen man's heart.

verses.lat: Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: illic pásseres nidificábunt.
verses.eng: The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which He hath planted: there the sparrows shall make their nests.

verses.lat: Heródii domus dux est eórum: montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.
verses.eng: The heron's house is the highest of them: the high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.

verses.lat: Fecit lunam in témpora: sol cognóvit occásum suum.
verses.eng: He hath made the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.lat: Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.
verses.eng: Thou hast appointed darkness, and it is night: in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about.

verses.lat: Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
verses.eng: The young lions roaring after their prey, and seeking their meat from God.

verses.lat: Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.
verses.eng: The sun ariseth, and they are gathered together: and they shall lie down in their dens.

verses.lat: Exíbit homo ad opus suum: et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperam.
verses.eng: Man shall go forth to his work, and to his labour until the evening.

verses.lat: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.
verses.eng: How great are Thy works, O Lord! Thou hast made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with Thy riches.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Hoc mare magnum et spatiósum mánibus: illic reptília, quorum non est númerus. Animália pusílla cum magnis:
verses.eng: So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: there are creeping things without number. Creatures little and great:

verses.lat: illic naves pertransíbunt: draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei.
verses.eng: there the ships shall go. This sea dragon which Thou hast formed to play therein.

verses.lat: Ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
verses.eng: All expect of Thee that Thou give them food in season.

verses.lat: Dante te illis, cólligent: aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
verses.eng: What Thou givest to them they shall gather up: when Thou openest Thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

verses.lat: Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
verses.eng: But if Thou turnest away Thy face, they shall be troubled: Thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

verses.lat: Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: et renovábis fáciem terræ.
verses.eng: Thou shalt send forth Thy spirit, and they shall be created: and Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

verses.lat: Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis.
verses.eng: May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in His works.

verses.lat: Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
verses.eng: He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.lat: Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: psallam Deo meo quámdiu sum.
verses.eng: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.lat: Jucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
verses.eng: Let my speech be acceptable to Him: but I will take delight in the Lord.

verses.lat: Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
verses.eng: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus: annuntiáte inter gentes ópera ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, and call upon His name: declare His deeds among the Gentiles.

verses.lat: Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: narráte ómnia mirabília ejus.
verses.eng: Sing to Him, yea sing praises to Him: relate all His wondrous works.

verses.lat: Laudámini in nómine sancto ejus: lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
verses.eng: Glory ye in His holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.lat: Quǽrite Dóminum et confirmámini: quǽrite fáciem ejus semper.
verses.eng: Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: seek His face evermore.

verses.lat: Meméntote mirabílium ejus, quæ fecit: prodígia ejus, et judícia oris ejus.
verses.eng: Remember His marvellous works which He hath done; His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth.

verses.lat: Semen Abraham, servi ejus: fílii Jacob, elécti ejus.
verses.eng: O ye seed of Abraham His servant; ye sons of Jacob His chosen.

verses.lat: Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: in univérsa terra judícia ejus.
verses.eng: He is the Lord our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.lat: Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
verses.eng: He hath remembered His covenant for ever: the word which He commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.lat: Quod dispósuit ad Abraham: et juraménti sui ad Isaac.
verses.eng: Which He made to Abraham: and His oath to Isaac.

verses.lat: Et státuit illud Jacob in præcéptum: et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
verses.eng: And He appointed it to Jacob for a law: and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

verses.lat: Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan: funículum hereditátis vestræ.
verses.eng: Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, the lot of your inheritance.

verses.lat: Cum essent número brevi, paucíssimi, et íncolæ ejus:
verses.eng: When they were but a small number: yea very few, and sojourners therein.

verses.lat: Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
verses.eng: And they passed from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.

verses.lat: Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: et corrípuit pro eis reges.
verses.eng: He suffered no man to hurt them: and He reproved kings for their sakes.

verses.lat: Nolíte tangere christos meos: et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
verses.eng: Touch ye not My anointed: and do no evil to My prophets.

verses.lat: Et vocávit famem super terram: et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
verses.eng: And He called a famine upon the land: and He destroyed all the provision of bread.

verses.lat: Misit ante eos virum: in servum venúndatus est Joseph.
verses.eng: He sent a man before them: Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

verses.lat: Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes ejus, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam ejus, donec veníret verbum ejus.
verses.eng: They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, until his word came.

verses.lat: Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: misit rex, et sólvit eum: princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
verses.eng: The word of the Lord inflamed him: the king sent and released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

verses.lat: Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
verses.eng: He made him master of his house, and ruler of all his possession.

verses.lat: Ut erudíret príncipes ejus sicut semetípsum: et senes ejus prudéntiam docéret.
verses.eng: That he might instruct his princes as himself, and teach his ancients wisdom.

verses.lat: Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: et Jacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
verses.eng: And Israel went into Egypt: and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

verses.lat: Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
verses.eng: And He increased His people exceedingly: and strengthened them over their enemies.

verses.lat: Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum ejus: et dolum fácerent in servos ejus.
verses.eng: He turned their heart to hate His people: and to deal deceitfully with His servants.

verses.lat: Misit Móysen, servum suum: Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
verses.eng: He sent Moses His servant: Aaron the man whom He had chosen.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum, et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
verses.eng: He gave them power to show His signs, and His wonders in the land of Cham.

verses.lat: Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
verses.eng: He sent darkness, and made it obscure: and grieved not His words.

verses.lat: Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: et occídit pisces eórum.
verses.eng: He turned their waters into blood, and destroyed their fish.

verses.lat: Édidit terra eórum ranas: in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
verses.eng: Their land brought forth frogs, in the inner chambers of their kings.

verses.lat: Dixit, et venit cœnomýia: et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
verses.eng: He spoke, and there came divers sorts of flies and sciniphs in all their coasts.

verses.lat: Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
verses.eng: He gave them hail for rain, a burning fire in the land.

verses.lat: Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
verses.eng: And He destroyed their vineyards and their fig trees: and He broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

verses.lat: Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, cujus non erat númerus:
verses.eng: He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, of which there was no number:

verses.lat: Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
verses.eng: And they devoured all the grass in their land, and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

verses.lat: Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: primítias omnis labóris eórum.
verses.eng: And He slew all the firstborn in their land: the firstfruits of all their labour.

verses.lat: Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
verses.eng: And He brought them out with silver and gold: and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

verses.lat: Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
verses.eng: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them lay upon them.

verses.lat: Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum, et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
verses.eng: He spread a cloud for their protection, and fire to give them light in the night.

verses.lat: Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: et pane cæli saturávit eos.
verses.eng: They asked, and the quail came: and He filled them with the bread of heaven.

verses.lat: Dirúpit petram, et fluxérunt aquæ: abiérunt in sicco flúmina.
verses.eng: He opened the rock, and waters flowed: rivers ran down in the dry land.

verses.lat: Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui, quod hábuit ad Abraham, púerum suum.
verses.eng: Because He remembered His holy word, which He had spoken to His servant Abraham.

verses.lat: Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
verses.eng: And He brought forth His people with joy, and His chosen with gladness.

verses.lat: Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: et labóres populórum possedérunt:
verses.eng: And He gave them the lands of the Gentiles: and they possessed the labours of the people:

verses.lat: Ut custódiant justificatiónes ejus, et legem ejus requírant.
verses.eng: That they might observe His justifications, and seek after His law.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini: audítas fáciet omnes laudes ejus?
verses.eng: Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? who shall set forth all His praises?

verses.lat: Beáti, qui custódiunt judícium, et fáciunt justítiam in omni témpore.
verses.eng: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and do justice at all times.

verses.lat: Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: vísita nos in salutári tuo:
verses.eng: Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of Thy people: visit us with Thy salvation.

verses.lat: Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
verses.eng: That we may see the good of Thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of Thy nation: that Thou mayst be praised with Thy inheritance.

verses.lat: Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: injúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
verses.eng: We have sinned with our fathers: we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

verses.lat: Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ. Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, Mare Rubrum.
verses.eng: Our fathers understood not Thy wonders in Egypt: they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies. And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, even the Red Sea.

verses.lat: Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
verses.eng: And He saved them for His own name's sake: that He might make His power known.

verses.lat: Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est: et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
verses.eng: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: and He led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

verses.lat: Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
verses.eng: And He saved them from the hand of them that hated them: and He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.lat: Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: unus ex eis non remánsit.
verses.eng: And the water covered them that afflicted them: there was not one of them left.

verses.lat: Et credidérunt verbis ejus: et laudavérunt laudem ejus.
verses.eng: And they believed His words: and they sang His praises.

verses.lat: Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum ejus: et non sustinuérunt consílium ejus.
verses.eng: They soon forgot His works: and they waited not for His counsel.

verses.lat: Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
verses.eng: And they coveted their desire in the desert: and they tempted God in the place without water.

verses.lat: Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
verses.eng: And He gave them their request: and sent fulness into their souls.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
verses.eng: And they provoked Moses in the camp, Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

verses.lat: Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
verses.eng: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: and covered the congregation of Abiron.

verses.lat: Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum: flamma combússit peccatóres.
verses.eng: And a fire was kindled in their congregation: the flame burned the wicked.

verses.lat: Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb: et adoravérunt scúlptile.
verses.eng: They made also a calf in Horeb: and they adored the graven thing.

verses.lat: Et mutavérunt glóriam suam in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
verses.eng: And they changed their glory into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

verses.lat: Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
verses.eng: They forgot God, who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

verses.lat: Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: si non Móyses, eléctus ejus, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu ejus: Ut avérteret iram ejus ne dispérderet eos:
verses.eng: And He said that He would destroy them: had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach: To turn away His wrath, lest He should destroy them:

verses.lat: et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderá­bilem. Non credidérunt verbo ejus,
verses.eng: and they set at nought the desirable land. They believed not His word,

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
verses.eng: and they murmured in their tents: they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

verses.lat: Et elevávit manum suam super eos: ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
verses.eng: And He lifted up His hand over them: to overthrow them in the desert:

verses.lat: Et ut dejíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
verses.eng: And to cast down their seed among the nations, and to scatter them in the countries.

verses.lat: Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
verses.eng: They also were initiated to Beelphegor: and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
verses.eng: And they provoked Him with their inventions: and destruction was multiplied among them.

verses.lat: Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: et cessávit quassátio.
verses.eng: Then Phinees stood up, and pacified Him: and the slaughter ceased.

verses.lat: Et reputátum est ei in justítiam: in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
verses.eng: And it was reputed to him unto justice, to generation and generation for evermore.

verses.lat: Et irritavérunt eum ad Aquas contradictiónis: et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum ejus.
verses.eng: They provoked Him also at the waters of contradiction: and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

verses.lat: Et distínxit in lábiis suis: non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
verses.eng: And he distinguished with his lips: they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

verses.lat: Et commíxti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: et factum est illis in scándalum.
verses.eng: And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, and it became a stumbling block to them.

verses.lat: Et immolavérunt fílios suos et fílias suas dæmóniis.
verses.eng: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to devils.

verses.lat: Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan. Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus,
verses.eng: And they shed innocent blood: the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan. And the land was polluted with blood,

verses.lat: et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
verses.eng: and was defiled with their works: and they went aside after their own inventions.

verses.lat: Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
verses.eng: And the Lord was exceedingly angry with His people: and He abhorred His inheritance.

verses.lat: Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
verses.eng: And He delivered them into the hands of the nations: and they that hated them had dominion over them.

verses.lat: Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: sǽpe liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands: many times did He deliver them.

verses.lat: Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
verses.eng: But they provoked Him with their counsel: and they were brought low by their iniquities.

verses.lat: Et vidit cum tribularéntur: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
verses.eng: And He saw when they were in tribulation: and He heard their prayer.

verses.lat: Et memor fuit testaménti sui: et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: And He was mindful of His covenant: and repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

verses.lat: Et dedit eos in misericórdias in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
verses.eng: And He gave them unto mercies, in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

verses.lat: Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: et cóngrega nos de natiónibus: Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: et gloriémur in laude tua.
verses.eng: Save us, O Lord, our God: and gather us from among the nations: That we may give thanks to Thy holy name, and may glory in Thy praise.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: Give glory to the Lord, for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
verses.eng: Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: and gathered out of the countries.

verses.lat: A solis ortu et occásu: ab aquilóne et mari.
verses.eng: From the rising and the setting of the sun, from the north and from the sea.

verses.lat: Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
verses.eng: They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Esuriéntes et sitiéntes: ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
verses.eng: They were hungry and thirsty: their soul fainted in them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And He led them into the right way: that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
verses.eng: For He hath satisfied the empty soul, and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

verses.lat: Sedéntes in ténebris et umbra mortis: vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
verses.eng: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: bound in want and in iron.

verses.lat: Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
verses.eng: Because they had exasperated the words of God: and provoked the counsel of the Most High.

verses.lat: Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adjuváret.
verses.eng: And their heart was humbled with labours: they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et edúxit eos de ténebris et umbra mortis: et víncula eórum dirúpit.
verses.eng: And He brought them out of darkness, and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: et vectes férreos confrégit.
verses.eng: Because He hath broken gates of brass, and burst iron bars.

verses.lat: Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: propter injustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: He took them out of the way of their iniquity: for they were brought low for their injustices.

verses.lat: Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
verses.eng: Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
verses.eng: He sent His word, and healed them: and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him: and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et sacrifícent sacrifícium laudis: et annúntient ópera ejus in exsultatióne.
verses.eng: And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: and declare His works with joy.

verses.lat: Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
verses.eng: They that go down to the sea in ships, doing business in the great waters:

verses.lat: Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, et mirabília ejus in profúndo.
verses.eng: These have seen the works of the Lord, and His wonders in the deep.

verses.lat: Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: et exaltáti sunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: and the waves thereof were lifted up.

verses.lat: Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
verses.eng: They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: their soul pined away with evils.

verses.lat: Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
verses.eng: They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

verses.lat: Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
verses.eng: And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: and He brought them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: Et státuit procéllam ejus in auram: et siluérunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: And He turned the storm into a breeze: and its waves were still.

verses.lat: Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
verses.eng: And they rejoiced because they were still: and He brought them to the haven which they wished for.

verses.lat: Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to Him, and His wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
verses.eng: And let them exalt Him in the church of the people: and praise Him in the chair of the ancients.

verses.lat: Pósuit flúmina in desértum: et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
verses.eng: He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: and the sources of waters into dry ground.

verses.lat: Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
verses.eng: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.lat: Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
verses.eng: He hath turned a wilderness into pools of waters, and a dry land into water springs.

verses.lat: Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: And there He placed the hungry; and they made a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
verses.eng: And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: and they yielded fruit of birth.

verses.lat: Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: et juménta eórum non minorávit.
verses.eng: And He blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: and their cattle He diminished not.

verses.lat: Et pauci facti sunt: et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum et dolóre.
verses.eng: Then they were brought to be few: and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

verses.lat: Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
verses.eng: Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: and He caused them to wander where there is no passing, and out of the way.

verses.lat: Et adjúvit páuperem de inópia: et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
verses.eng: And He helped the poor out of poverty: and made him families like a flock of sheep.

verses.lat: Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
verses.eng: The just shall see, and shall rejoice, and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.lat: Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? et intélleget misericórdias Dómini?
verses.eng: Who is wise, and will keep these things: and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Miserére mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam. Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, dele iniquitátem meam.
verses.eng: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Thy great mercy. And according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.

verses.lat: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: et a peccáto meo munda me.
verses.eng: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.lat: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
verses.eng: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.

verses.lat: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
verses.eng: To Thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before Thee: that Thou mayst be justified in Thy words, and mayst overcome when Thou art judged.

verses.lat: Ecce enim in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
verses.eng: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; and in sins did my mother conceive me.

verses.lat: Ecce enim veritátem dilexísti: incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
verses.eng: For behold Thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of Thy wisdom Thou hast made manifest to me.

verses.lat: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
verses.eng: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: Thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

verses.lat: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
verses.eng: To my hearing Thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
verses.eng: Turn away Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.lat: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
verses.eng: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

verses.lat: Ne projícias me a fácie tua: et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
verses.eng: Cast me not away from Thy face; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

verses.lat: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: et spíritu principáli confírma me.
verses.eng: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

verses.lat: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: et ímpii ad te converténtur.
verses.eng: I will teach the unjust Thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to Thee.

verses.lat: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
verses.eng: Deliver me from blood, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol Thy justice.

verses.lat: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
verses.eng: O Lord, Thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.

verses.lat: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: holocáustis non delectáberis.
verses.eng: For if Thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings Thou wilt not be delighted.

verses.lat: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: cor contrítum et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
verses.eng: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.lat: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
verses.eng: Deal favourably, O Lord, in Thy good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

verses.lat: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes et holocáusta: tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
verses.eng: Then shalt Thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon Thy altar.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Bonum est confitéri Dómino: et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
verses.eng: It is good to give praise to the Lord: and to sing to Thy name, O Most High.

verses.lat: Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: et veritátem tuam per noctem.
verses.eng: To show forth Thy mercy in the morning, and Thy truth in the night.

verses.lat: In decachórdo, psaltério: cum cántico, in cíthara.
verses.eng: Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: with a canticle upon the harp.

verses.lat: Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
verses.eng: For Thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in Thy doings: and in the works of Thy hands I shall rejoice.

verses.lat: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
verses.eng: O Lord, how great are Thy works! Thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

verses.lat: Vir insípiens non cognóscet: et stultus non intélleget hæc.
verses.eng: The senseless man shall not know: nor will the fool understand these things.

verses.lat: Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: et apparúerint omnes qui operántur iniquitátem: Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi:
verses.eng: When the wicked shall spring up as grass: and all the workers of iniquity shall appear: That they may perish for ever and ever:

verses.lat: tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
verses.eng: but Thou, O Lord, art Most High for evermore.

verses.lat: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: et dispergéntur omnes qui operántur iniquitátem.
verses.eng: For behold Thy enemies, O Lord, for behold Thy enemies shall perish: and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.lat: Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
verses.eng: But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: and my old age in plentiful mercy.

verses.lat: Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
verses.eng: My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

verses.lat: Justus ut palma florébit: sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
verses.eng: The just shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

verses.lat: Plantáti in domo Dómini, in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
verses.eng: They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

verses.lat: Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
verses.eng: They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: and shall be well treated, that they may show:

verses.lat: Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: et non est iníquitas in eo.
verses.eng: That the Lord our God is righteous, and there is no iniquity in Him.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: áudiat terra verba oris mei.
verses.eng: Hear, O ye heavens, the things I speak: let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.lat: Concrescat ut plúvia doctrína mea, fluat ut ros elóquium meum, quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina.
verses.eng: Let my doctrine gather as the rain, let my speech distil as the dew, as a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass.

verses.lat: Quia nomen Dómini invocábo: date magnificéntiam Deo nostro.
verses.eng: Because I will invoke the name of the Lord: give ye magnificence to our God.

verses.lat: Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ ejus judícia: Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, justus et rectus.
verses.eng: The works of God are perfect, and all His ways are judgments: God is faithful and without any iniquity, He is just and right.

verses.lat: Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii ejus in sórdibus: generátio prava atque pervérsa.
verses.eng: They have sinned against Him, and are none of His children in their filth: they are a wicked and perverse generation.

verses.lat: Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens? numquid non ipse est pater tuus, qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?
verses.eng: Is this the return thou makest to the Lord, O foolish and senseless people? Is not He thy Father, that hath possessed thee, and made thee, and created thee?

verses.lat: Meménto diérum antiquórum, cógita generatiónes síngulas: intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi, majóres tuos, et dicent tibi.
verses.eng: Remember the days of old, think upon every generation: ask thy father, and he will declare to thee: thy elders, and they will tell thee.

verses.lat: Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes, quando separábat fílios Adam, constítuit términos populórum juxta númerum filiórum Israël.
verses.eng: When the Most High divided the nations, when He separated the sons of Adam, He appointed the bounds of people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.lat: Pars autem Dómini, pópulus ejus: Jacob funículus hereditátis ejus.
verses.eng: But the Lord's portion is His people: Jacob the lot of His inheritance.

verses.lat: Invénit eum in terra desérta, in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis: circúmduxit eum, et dócuit: et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.
verses.eng: He found him in a desert land, in a place of horror and of vast wilderness: He led him about, and taught him: and He kept him as the apple of His eye.

verses.lat: Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, et super eos vólitans, expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, atque portávit in húmeris suis.
verses.eng: As the eagle enticing her young to fly, and hovering over them, He spread His wings, and hath taken him and carried him on His shoulders.

verses.lat: Dóminus solus dux ejus fuit: et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.
verses.eng: The Lord alone was his leader: and there was no strange god with him.

verses.lat: Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: ut coméderet fructus agrórum, ut súgeret mel de petra, oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.
verses.eng: He set him upon high land: that he might eat the fruits of the fields, that he might suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the hardest stone.

verses.lat: Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus, cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan: et hircos cum medúlla trítici, et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.
verses.eng: Butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep with the fat of lambs, and of rams of the breed of Basan: and goats with the marrow of wheat, and might drink the purest blood of the grape.

verses.lat: Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus, derelíquit Deum factórem suum, et recéssit a Deo salutári suo.
verses.eng: The beloved grew fat, and kicked: he grew fat, and thick and gross: he forsook God who made him, and departed from God his Saviour.

verses.lat: Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.
verses.eng: They provoked Him with strange gods, and stirred Him up to anger with their abominations.

verses.lat: Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, diis quos ignorábant: novi recentésque venérunt, quos non coluérunt patres eórum.
verses.eng: They sacrificed to devils and not to God, to gods whom they knew not: that were newly come up, whom their fathers worshipped not.

verses.lat: Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, et oblítus es Dómini creatóris tui.
verses.eng: Thou hast forsaken the God that begot thee, and hast forgotten the Lord that created thee.

verses.lat: Vidit Dóminus, et ad iracúndiam concitátus est: quia provocavérunt eum fílii sui et fíliæ.
verses.eng: The Lord saw, and was moved to wrath, because His own sons and daughters provoked Him.

verses.lat: Et ait: Abscóndam fáciem meam ab eis, et considerábo novíssima eórum: generátio enim pervérsa est, et infidéles fílii.
verses.eng: And He said: I will hide My face from them, and will consider what their last end shall be: for it is a perverse generation, and unfaithful children.

verses.lat: Ipsi me provocavérunt in eo, qui non erat Deus, et irritavérunt in vanitátibus suis: et ego provocábo eos in eo, qui non est pópulus, et in gente stulta irritábo illos.
verses.eng: They have provoked Me with that which was no god, and have angered Me with their vanities: and I will provoke them with that which is no people, and will vex them with a foolish nation.

verses.lat: Ignis succénsus est in furóre meo, et ardébit usque ad inférni novíssima: devorábítque terram cum gérmine suo, et móntium fundaménta combúret.
verses.eng: A fire is kindled in My wrath, and shall burn even to the lowest hell: and shall devour the earth with her increase, and shall burn the foundations of the mountains.

verses.lat: Congregábo super eos mala, et sagíttas meas complébo in eis.
verses.eng: I will heap evils upon them, and will spend My arrows among them.

verses.lat: Consuméntur fame, et devorábunt eos aves morsu amaríssimo: dentes bestiárum immíttam in eos, cum furóre trahéntium super terram, atque serpéntium.
verses.eng: They shall be consumed with famine, and birds shall devour them with a most bitter bite: I will send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the fury of creatures that trail upon the ground, and of serpents.

verses.lat: Foris vastábit eos gládius, et intus pavor, júvenem simul ac vírginem, lacténtem cum hómine sene.
verses.eng: Without, the sword shall lay them waste, and terror within: the young man and the virgin together, the suckling with the man in years.

verses.lat: Dixi: Ubínam sunt? cessáre fáciam ex homínibus memóriam eórum.
verses.eng: I said: Where are they? I will make the memory of them to cease from among men.

verses.lat: Sed propter iram inimicórum dístuli: ne forte superbírent hostes eórum. Et dícerent: Manus nostra excélsa, et non Dóminus, fecit hæc ómnia.
verses.eng: But for the wrath of the enemies I have deferred it: lest perhaps their enemies might be proud, and should say: Our mighty hand, and not the Lord, hath done all these things.

verses.lat: Gens absque consílio est, et sine prudéntia. Utínam sáperent et intellégerent, ac novíssima providérent!
verses.eng: They are a nation without counsel, and without wisdom. O that they would be wise and would understand, and would provide for their last end.

verses.lat: Quómodo persequátur unus mille, et duo fugent decem míllia? nonne ídeo, quia Deus suus véndidit eos, et Dóminus conclúsit illos?
verses.eng: How should one pursue after a thousand, and two chase ten thousand? Was it not because their God had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?

verses.lat: Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eórum: et inimíci nostri sunt júdices.
verses.eng: For our God is not as their gods: our enemies themselves are judges.

verses.lat: De vínea Sodomórum, vínea eórum, et de suburbánis Gomórrhæ: uva eórum uva fellis, et botri amaríssimi.
verses.eng: Their vine is of the vineyard of Sodom, and of the suburbs of Gomorrha: their grapes are grapes of gall, and their clusters most bitter.

verses.lat: Fel dracónum vinum eórum: et venénum áspidum insanábile.
verses.eng: Their wine is the gall of dragons, and the venom of asps, which is incurable.

verses.lat: Nonne hæc cóndita sunt apud me, et signáta in thesáuris meis?
verses.eng: Are not these things stored up with Me, and sealed up in My treasures?

verses.lat: Mea est últio, et ego retríbuam in témpore, ut labátur pes eórum: juxta est dies perditiónis, et adésse festínant témpora.
verses.eng: Revenge is Mine, and I will repay them in due time, that their foot may slide: the day of destruction is at hand, and the time makes haste to come.

verses.lat: Judicábit Dóminus pópulum suum, et in servis suis misereábitur: vidébit quod infirmáta sit manus, et clausi quoque defecérunt, residuíque consúmpti sunt.
verses.eng: The Lord will judge His people, and will have mercy on His servants: He shall see that their hand is weakened, and that they who were shut up have also failed, and they that remained are consumed.

verses.lat: Et dicet: Ubi sunt dii eórum, in quibus habébant fidúciam?
verses.eng: And He shall say: Where are their gods, in whom they trusted?

verses.lat: De quorum víctimis comedébant ádipes, et bibébant vinum libáminum: surgant, et opituléntur vobis, et in necessitáte vos prótegant.
verses.eng: Of whose victims they ate the fat, and drank the wine of their drink offerings: let them arise and help you, and protect you in your distress.

verses.lat: Vidéte quod ego sim solus, et non sit álius Deus præter me: ego occídam, et ego vívere fáciam: percútiam, et ego sanábo, et non est qui de manu mea possit erúere.
verses.eng: See ye that I alone am, and there is no other God besides Me: I will kill and I will make to live: I will strike, and I will heal, and there is none that can deliver out of My hand.

verses.lat: Levábo ad cælum manum meam, et dicam: Vivo ego in ætérnum.
verses.eng: I will lift up My hand to heaven, and I will say: I live for ever.

verses.lat: Si acúero ut fulgur gládium meum, et arrípuerit judícium manus mea: reddam ultiónem hóstibus meis, et his qui odérunt me retríbuam.
verses.eng: If I shall whet My sword as the lightning, and My hand take hold on judgment: I will render vengeance to My enemies, and repay them that hate Me.

verses.lat: Inebriábo sagíttas meas sánguine, et gládius meus devorábit carnes, de cruóre occisórum, et de captivitáte, nudáti inimicórum cápitis.
verses.eng: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, of the blood of the slain and of the captivity, of the bare head of the enemies.

verses.lat: Laudáte, gentes, pópulum ejus, quia sánguinem servórum suórum ulciscétur: et vindíctam retríbuet in hostes eórum, et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
verses.eng: Praise His people, ye nations, for He will avenge the blood of His servants: and will render vengeance to their enemies, and He will be merciful to the land of His people.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, et dígitos meos ad bellum.
verses.eng: Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, and my fingers to war.

verses.lat: Misericórdia mea et refúgium meum: suscéptor meus et liberátor meus: Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
verses.eng: My mercy and my refuge: my support and my deliverer: My protector, and I have hoped in Him: who subdueth my people under me.

verses.lat: Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
verses.eng: Lord, what is man, that Thou art made known to him? or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?

verses.lat: Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: dies ejus sicut umbra prætéreunt.
verses.eng: Man is like to vanity: his days pass away like a shadow.

verses.lat: Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: tange montes, et fumigábunt.
verses.eng: Lord, bow down Thy heavens and descend: touch the mountains and they shall smoke.

verses.lat: Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
verses.eng: Send forth lightning, and Thou shalt scatter them: shoot out Thy arrows, and Thou shalt trouble them.

verses.lat: Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: de manu filiórum alienórum.
verses.eng: Put forth Thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: from the hand of strange children.

verses.lat: Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
verses.eng: Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
verses.eng: To Thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to Thee.

verses.lat: Qui das salútem régibus: qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
verses.eng: Who givest salvation to kings: who hast redeemed Thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me.

verses.lat: Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
verses.eng: And rescue me out of the hand of strange children, whose mouth hath spoken vanity: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

verses.lat: Quorum fílii sicut novéllæ plantatiónes in juventúte sua. Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
verses.eng: Whose sons are as new plants in their youth: Their daughters decked out, adorned round about after the similitude of a temple.

verses.lat: Promptuária eórum plena, eructántia ex hoc in illud. Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: boves eórum crassæ.
verses.eng: Their storehouses full, flowing out of this into that. Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: their oxen fat.

verses.lat: Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: neque clamor in platéis eórum.
verses.eng: There is no breach of wall, nor passage, nor crying out in their streets.

verses.lat: Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: beátus pópulus, cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
verses.eng: They have called the people happy that hath these things: but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Exaltábo te, Deus meus, Rex: et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: I will extol Thee, O God my King: and I will bless Thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: Every day I will bless Thee: and I will praise Thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Magnus Dóminus et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
verses.eng: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: and of His greatness there is no end.

verses.lat: Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
verses.eng: Generation and generation shall praise Thy works: and they shall declare Thy power.

verses.lat: Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: et mirabília tua narrábunt.
verses.eng: They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of Thy holiness: and shall tell Thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
verses.eng: And they shall speak of the might of Thy terrible acts: and shall declare Thy greatness.

verses.lat: Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: et justítia tua exsultábunt.
verses.eng: They shall publish the memory of the abundance of Thy sweetness: and shall rejoice in Thy justice.

verses.lat: Miserátor et miséricors Dóminus: pátiens et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: The Lord is gracious and merciful: patient and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: Suávis Dóminus univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
verses.eng: The Lord is sweet to all: and His tender mercies are over all His works.

verses.lat: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
verses.eng: Let all Thy works, O Lord, praise Thee: and let Thy saints bless Thee.

verses.lat: Glóriam regni tui dicent: et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
verses.eng: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom: and shall tell of Thy power:

verses.lat: Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
verses.eng: To make Thy might known to the sons of men: and the glory of the magnificence of Thy kingdom.

verses.lat: Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
verses.eng: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: and Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.lat: Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: The Lord is faithful in all His words: and holy in all His works.

verses.lat: Allevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: et érigit omnes elísos.
verses.eng: The Lord lifteth up all that fall: and setteth up all that are cast down.

verses.lat: Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
verses.eng: The eyes of all hope in Thee, O Lord: and Thou givest them meat in due season.

verses.lat: Áperis tu manum tuam: et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
verses.eng: Thou openest Thy hand, and fillest with blessing every living creature.

verses.lat: Justus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
verses.eng: The Lord is just in all His ways: and holy in all His works.

verses.lat: Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
verses.eng: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon Him: to all that call upon Him in truth.

verses.lat: Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet, et salvos fáciet eos.
verses.eng: He will do the will of them that fear Him: and He will hear their prayer, and save them.

verses.lat: Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
verses.eng: The Lord keepeth all them that love Him: but all the wicked He will destroy.

verses.lat: Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto ejus in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless His holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
verses.eng: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
